entities.summary: One of the world's oldest continuously inhabited cities, Varanasi (Benares/Kashi) sits on the Ganges in northern India and is the holiest city in Hinduism, significant in Buddhism and Jainism. For over 3,000 years, millions of pilgrims have come to bathe in the Ganges, cremate their dead on its ghats, and seek spiritual liberation (moksha) in this "City of Light."
